data.narrative:
Zeromark is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis benchmarks against a peer set of 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies spanning Series A and Seed rounds, with a median valuation of $1.0B and a range from $125M to $4.0B. The broader Defense & Security landscape includes 10 comparable companies (2 public, 8 private), anchored by peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $25M. Peer-median analysis applies the $1.0B median valuation across the 5-company peer cohort, reflecting market pricing for similar-stage Defense & Security companies. These methods produce a wide range reflecting inherent uncertainty at the Seed stage.

Triangulating these two approaches yields a valuation range of $21M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $512M. The substantial spread reflects two competing signals: early-stage financing ($10M raised) suggests a lower valuation, while peer multiples signal significantly higher market values for Defense & Security Seed/Series A companies. Key uncertainties include product-market validation, differentiation relative to peers, and capital efficiency trajectory.
